fact: The Office of the Accountant General directed federal ministries and agencies to integrate the Government Payroll System with the National Identification System run by NIRA, with a pilot in five institutions from 1 October 2026 and full implementation targeted for 31 December 2027.
NIRA's director general says the electoral commission is responsible for using the ID card to verify people registering to vote (BBC Somali).
EUAA reports, citing a World Bank team, that business registration is among the uses of the NIRA ID as of March 2026.
